description: This warbird is common within the Romulan Free State, and the perfect choice for a secretive sect that wants to remain under the radar. Built with speed and stealth in mind, the warbird boasts an elegant, aerodynamic design and advanced cloaking technology. This particular model - the Praefortis - was listed as destroyed in battle, and written off by the Tal Shiar. Interesting, then, that it has been spotted skulking around the Margins...

ship_ability.title: Through the Veil
ship_ability.description: Increases Isolytic Damage by +{value} vs all oponents in the Veil (does not apply to Stations).
